app.name: SQL Learning App
app.tagline: Write it. Run it. Learn it.

home.eyebrow: SQL practice that runs entirely in your browser
home.title: SQL Learning App
home.description: Write real SQL in your browser and run it instantly. Your SQL runs entirely on your own device — nothing is ever sent to a server.

instant.title: Run instantly
instant.body: Ctrl+Enter and the result is right there. Nothing interrupts your trial-and-error loop.

private.title: Your data stays local
private.body: SQLite runs inside the browser. The SQL you write never leaves your device.

guided.title: Hints when you're stuck
guided.body: Step-by-step hints and a full explanation — with room to think before you peek.

problemList.title: Problems
problemList.subtitle: Work through them in order — from basic SELECTs to aggregation and joins.

problemSolve.incorrect: ❌ Not quite right. Give it another try.
